guidance_change: Raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $5.75–5.85B from $5.45–5.60B
what_changed: Q3 EPS of $1.79 beat the $1.62 consensus by 10.5%.
Revenue of $1,512M grew 42.6% year over year, faster than Q2's 39.8%.
FY2026 revenue guidance raised to $5.75–5.85B from $5.45–5.60B on 1.6T transceiver and rack-system demand.
